items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: He played manjo with us...when I first...I started playing with classic

ctx.x: No shit... I think it was my last dollar... At the...at the rendezvous with Bourbon and St. Peter...it was really a rough deal...

Yeah...he was a character... He played manjo with us...when I first...I started playing with classic...and I don't know what happened...but he got away...and... Little Freddie...we got Freddie...and Lloyd Cantor to play... Now first...Joe...Joe started playing...and he...Joe said to us...man I got a kid...but he plays nice... Uh...Ghetto...and...we knew Joe...Joe played sax...so bring him around...so he brought little Freddie... Freddie was bashful...bashful as he could be...man...so...he sat in with the…
